comment: Frame 020, printed p. 14: division continued: the divisor moved one place to the right after each round, a place with a circle not passed over; what stands above the divisor at the end is the quotient, what remains is a part of one; division the converse of multiplication; the example of division, 46468 by 324, set out.

observations: The page number «( 14 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

L29-L33: the example of division, forty-six thousand four hundred and sixty-eight, «quadraginta sex milia et quadrigentos sexaginta octo», by three hundred and twenty-four, «tercentos .xxiiii.», written place by place from the right. L30: «quadrigentos», without the n, as on p. 9 (frame 015, L11); L33 has «quadringenti».

L21: a dark speck, 8 by 8 px, stands above the second stem of the n of «narrauimus», so that the letter looks like «ri»; the letter is an n, its two stems joined by the arch. Transcribed «narrauimus».

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): without a space after the comma, L02 «numero,et» (10 px, the median word space of the line 16.5 px), L03 «fac,donec» (5 px), L15 «uidi,semper» (7 px) and L24 «diuidis,et» (6 px); with a space before the mark, L11 «inferioris ;» (10 px), L13 «differentiis :» (20 px) and L17 «numeri :» (19 px). L23 «uni:» (8 px before the colon) is set close.
Marks not transcribed: light specks at mid-height between «si» and «fuerit» (L17) and between «diuidis,» and «illud» (L23), and after «errasti.» (L26).
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: «quod» in the left margin beside L06, with «et» underlined; «quod» in the right margin beside L12 and L13, with «et» underlined in both lines; a mark above «narrauimus» (L21); «quia» in the left margin beside L28, with «quare» underlined. Not part of the edition.
